structured_payload.reason: Apple’s June quarter shows accelerating fundamental strength, with revenue up 16.36% year over year to $109.417B and net income up 27.12% to $29.789B. Margins expanded sharply: gross margin reached 50.06%, operating margin 32.62%, and net margin 27.23%. Operating cash flow rose 43.11% year-to-date to $116.996B, while capital expenditures declined 28.23%, driving free cash flow to $110.197B. The balance sheet also improved, with long-term debt down 13.45% and shareholders’ equity up 63.33%. Overall, the certified SEC data supports a bullish fundamental outlook.
